round1_adjudication.round1: medium DeleteAccountSheet.kt:107 Keep/dismiss active during in-flight delete
round1_adjudication.evidence: Keep is enabled = !state.deleting (TmrSecondaryButton, assertIsNotEnabled passes, so the disabled state is in semantics). DeleteAccountSheet sets sheetHost.dismissible = !deleting in a SideEffect; TmrSheetHostState.dismiss() is a no-op while false, which blocks scrim, back (TmrBottomSheet BackHandler -> onDismiss) and the TmrShell LaunchedEffect(key) dismiss. dismissible cannot be left false on a live host: current has a private setter so only show() (resets to true) or dismiss() changes it; a failed or LocalWipePending delete sets deleting=false and the SideEffect restores true; Deleted re-roots via key(accountId), which disposes the shell and its remembered host; an activity recreation builds a new host. The delete coroutine runs in NonCancellable, so cancellation cannot strand deleting=true on a host that survives. keepAndDismissDoNothingWhileTheDeleteIsInFlight and keepIsAvailableAgainAfterAFailedDelete prove it. Residual: the scrim still announces a Dismiss action (new low finding).

findings.rule: Data deletion scope (security review): a general writer must only delete what it owns; Ponytail 'error handling that prevents data loss'
findings.trigger: write() now deletes every entry of target.parentFile. TestAccountDataExporter (core/testing main source, TestAccountDataExporter.kt:15-16) passes File.createTempFile("test-account-data", ".zip"), whose parent is java.io.tmpdir (no build override: no tmpdir setting in build-logic or gradle.properties). Run ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest or verify-local.sh outside the Claude sandbox: TestAccountDataExporterContractTest, CollectAccountDataUseCaseTest.exportingHandsTheSnapshotToTheExporter and SettingsViewModelTest.downloadEmitsShareOnce each call deleteRecursively on every file and folder in the JVM temp dir, which is the per-user /var/folders/.../T on macOS (other apps' temp files) and /tmp on the Linux CI runners. With org.gradle.parallel=true and workers.max=3 it also deletes other test JVMs' TemporaryFolder roots and Robolectric temp app dirs mid-run, which makes them flaky. The Fixer's sandboxed run most likely hid this, because the sandbox denies those deletes. Production is safe today only because both production callers use cacheDir/data-exports. The line is also not needed. renameTo already replaces the fixed-name zip, the finally block removes the .tmp file, and DataExportsStartTask clears stale archives. Remove the line, or clear the directory inside the exporters that own EXPORT_DIRECTORY.
findings.title: Archive writer deletes every sibling of its target; the test fake points it at the JVM temp directory
findings.proof: AccountDataArchiveWriterTest: val bystander = folder.newFile("unrelated.txt"); AccountDataArchiveWriter().write(data, File(folder.root, "export.zip")); assertThat(bystander.exists()).isTrue(). It fails at this head.

findings.rule: 283-c8 / I.5 privacy: 'Account deleted' must mean the server account was deleted
findings.trigger: Prod: account A leaves a SERVER_CLOSED marker with no owner (a legacy marker without a uid, or markRequested() at line 144 when currentAccount() was null), and the local finish fails (RemoteAccountWipeFinisher signs A out and then wipeAll throws). Account B signs in on the same install. RemoteSignInGateway.kt:49-56 clears only a marker with a non-null, different owner, so the ownerless marker survives. B opens Settings and confirms Delete account. serverAlreadyClosedThisAccount() returns true because markerOwner == null, so line 63 calls settlePendingWipe -> FinishPendingAccountWipeUseCase.wipe(), which wipes local data and signs B out. The result is Deleted, and B sees 'Account deleted', but DELETE /v1/me is never sent for B, so B's server account and data remain. Before this diff the same path ran markRequested(B) and the server delete. Fix: adopt without a server call only when markerOwner == currentId. For a null owner, probe serverAccountDeleter.isClosed() for the current session, or run the normal delete, before skipping it.
findings.title: A SERVER_CLOSED marker with no owner skips the server delete for whichever account is signed in
findings.proof: DeleteAccountEarlierAttemptTest: marker.current = SERVER_CLOSED, marker.markerUid = null, current account uid-b, deleteResult = success. Run useCase()() and assert the server deleter was called once. It is called zero times today.

findings.rule: 283-c3 Download my data: the shared archive must stay readable for the share it was granted to
findings.trigger: Tap Download my data and share to a target that reads the URI later, for example a Drive upload or a draft attachment. The system kills the backgrounded app process, which is common on the low-RAM devices the app targets. When the target opens content://.../data-exports/tailormyresume-my-data.zip, the system cold-starts the process. TailorMyResumeApplication.onCreate runs startTasks (TailorMyResumeApplication.kt:15), and this task launches deleteRecursively on IO at the same time as FileProvider.openFile on a binder thread. If the delete wins, the target gets FileNotFoundException and the share fails. Fix: delete only archives older than a set age (lastModified), not every archive unconditionally.
findings.title: Start-time data-exports wipe races a share target's cold-start read of the granted URI
findings.proof: DataExportsStartTaskTest: write the archive with lastModified = now, call start(), and assert that a just-written archive survives. It fails today.

findings.rule: Accessibility: a control must not announce an action it will not perform
